The '''Annecy sector''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Slice" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Dona Laza sector/Legends|Dona Laza sector]] [[spinward]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian]] and [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sectors]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]]. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] also formed a four-way border with the [[Biivren sector/Legends|Biivren sector]], the [[Couronne sector/Legends|Couronne sector]], and the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]] at its [[trailing]] edge.<ref name="Expansion">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region}}</ref> The Annecy sector contained the [[New Raithal system/Legends|New Raithal system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which in turn shared its name with the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Annecy sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the [[2012]] StarWars.com article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20170806141020/http://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid square P-9.<ref name="Expansion" />
